types.label: City / service-area page
types.source: src/data/areas.ts → areas[] (matched by slug). Rendered fields: title, metaDescription, h1, lead, summary, sections, geography, faqs, nearby, image.
types.research: Census facts (population, year, source), ZIP codes, county, drive distance from the Greenville base, the main roads and exits through town, and the "tree service {city} sc" SERP and local pack. Every fact goes into the research file with its source before it is used in copy. Only the fields the template renders are seeded.

types.label: Service page
types.source: src/data/services.ts → services[] (matched by slug). Rendered fields: title, metaDescription, h1, lead, summary, sections, steps, faqs, related, ctaText.
types.research: Keywords "{service} near me" and "{service} greenville sc". Keyword metrics, top 10 results, People Also Ask, and the H2 outline of the top 3 pages. Note subtopics we do not cover. FAQs come from PAA. Never post prices unless business-profile.json allows it.

types.label: Service × city combo page
types.source: src/data/combos.ts → combos[] (matched by area + service). Rendered fields: title, metaDescription, h1, lead, sections, faqs.
types.research: Reuse the city research. Add only what is specific to this service in this town (for example the road where these calls happen). The goal is a unique lead paragraph so combo pages are not near-duplicates.
